text:
The response is accurate on the key facts: the Saturday 31 October reopening, the eight-month, $3.2 million upgrade and its joint funding, the pool and accessibility changes, the enrolment date, the prices, opening-day details and hours all match the source. Two small inaccuracies remain. It drops "expected" from the solar claim, turning a projection into a fact. It also says prices are unchanged "for 2026-27" when the source says "for the rest of the 2026-27 season." Neither is material to a manager. It omits the heated pool's year-round lessons benefit, a minor point. At about 105 words it is well under the limit and well organised for a busy reader, and the omitted quotes and anecdotes are rightly left out.

Score: 8
